name: Find the father of William A. Bagley (Topsham, VT, 1815-1884)
researcher_question: Who was the father of William A. Bagley, born about 1815 and died 31 May 1884 in Topsham, Orange County, Vermont?
notes: Father named directly on William's own 1884 death-record town-clerk entry; single-record answer, no cross-record reasoning required. Authored to exercise the GPS guardrail-enforcement changes end to end, not as a benchmark stress case.
